response: Yes, size-reducing ascending aortoplasty with external reinforcement is a safe and viable option in modern aortic surgery. According to studies, this procedure has excellent long-term results, particularly in patients with poststenotic dilatation of the aorta without impairment of the sinotubular junction of the aortic valve and root. It is considered a therapeutic option for these specific cases, offering a promising treatment approach with favorable outcomes.
